真正的黄金大世要降临了（真正的黄金大世要降临了（第22页）四祖忍不住爆了一句粗口，声音都在发抖，“渊儿，你……你这气息……”
就连六祖江无晦那正啃着灵果的分身，直接把果核给咽了下去，一双桃花眼瞪得溜圆：“乖乖……大帝后期？！
我滴个亲娘咧，你小子是吃仙丹长大的吗？你那……就连大帝后期的瓶颈都能让你一日升一境？乖乖！
闻言，江渊摇了摇头，摆出一副可惜但很欠打的样子，无奈叹了口气：“哪有啊，现在修炼艰难，我这次可是两日才升一境，修炼速度足足降低了50呢！”
听听，这是人话吗？两日升一境，你叫修炼艰难？那他们这些突破到大帝境中期后足足有十几万年都没突破到后期的人算什么？算他们足够有毅力？可恶啊。
他在心中哀嚎，“老子辛辛苦苦闭关，九死一生才证道大帝，虽然是得了渊儿的机缘吧，可……这，这小子，直接窜到了大帝后期，这还让不让人活了啊！”
江渊看着众人那震惊到无以复加的表情，心中的恶趣味得到了极大的满足。
他收敛了一闪而过的气息，大殿内那种让人窒息的压迫感瞬间消失。
随后，他面对着江守拙，恭恭敬敬地再行了一个晚辈礼。
“三伯闭关大成，证道大帝，渊儿还未曾当面道贺，今日一见，三伯神威内敛，气象万千，真乃我江家之大幸。”
江渊这番话说得极为诚恳，没有丝毫大帝后期强者的架子，完全就是一个乖巧懂事的晚辈。
江守拙被江渊这突如其来的一拜弄得手足无措，连忙伸手将他扶起，老脸上的尴尬之色更浓了：“咳咳……那个，渊儿啊，快起来快起来。
你这……你这修为，真是吓死三伯了。
三伯这点微末道行，在你面前，哪里敢称什么神威啊……”
江渊反握住江守拙的手，目光真诚，“无论渊儿修为多高，走到什么境界，在这江家，我永远都是您的侄儿。
长幼尊卑，血脉亲情，岂是区区修为可以抹杀的？三伯为了家族隐忍多年，如今一朝证道，这是您的本事，渊儿能有今日，也多亏了家族和长辈们的庇护。”
这番话，江渊说得掷地有声，发自肺腑。
他江渊虽然行事霸道，对外人冷酷无情，但对江家，对这些从小看着他长大、甚至在他是个凡人时依然对他宠溺有加的长辈，他有着绝对的敬意与维护。
他重重地拍了拍江渊的肩膀，心中的那一丝失落与尴尬瞬间烟消云散，取而代之的是无尽的欣慰与自豪。
就冲你这句话，以后谁敢动你一根汗毛，三伯拼了这条老命也要锤死他！”
大殿内的气氛，因为叔侄俩这温馨的互动，再次变得融洽起来。
“行了行了，你们爷俩就别互相吹捧了。”
四祖哈哈大笑，“渊儿，你小子今天故意露这么一手，把我们几个老家伙吓得够呛，肯定不只是为了显摆吧？而且还带了个女娃子过来，说吧，到底出什么事了？”
江渊嘿嘿一笑，指了指旁边站着，连大气都不敢喘的小丹仙。
“没什么大事，就是给三爷爷，送个徒弟过来。”

Chapter 524 The real golden age is coming (page 1)
The real golden age is about to come (The real golden age is about to come (page 22)) The Fourth Patriarch couldn't help but curse, his voice was trembling, "Yuan'er, you...your aura..."
Even the clone of the Sixth Patriarch Jiang Wuhui, who was gnawing on the spiritual fruit, swallowed the core directly, his peach blossom eyes widened: "Good boy... the late emperor?!
My dear mother, did you grow up taking elixirs? You... even the bottleneck of the late emperor can make you rise to a higher level in a day? Be good!
Hearing this, Jiang Yuan shook his head, pretending to be a pity but in need of a beating, and sighed helplessly: "No way, it's difficult to practice now. I only reached a level in two days this time, and my practice speed has been reduced by a full 50!"
Listen, is this human talk? Reaching a level in two days, you call cultivation difficult? So who do they think they are, who have not broken through to the late stage for hundreds of thousands of years after breaking through to the middle stage of the Great Emperor Realm? Are they considered perseverant enough? Damn it.
He wailed in his heart, "I worked hard in seclusion and narrowly escaped death to become the Great Emperor. Although it was probably because of Yuan'er's chance, but... this, this kid, directly reached the late stage of the Great Emperor. This is not going to allow anyone to live!"
Jiang Yuan looked at the extremely shocked expressions of everyone, and the evil taste in his heart was greatly satisfied.
He restrained his fleeting breath, and the suffocating sense of oppression in the hall disappeared instantly.
Then, he faced Jiang Shouzhuo and respectfully performed another junior salute.
"San Bo has achieved great success in seclusion and has become a great emperor. Yuan'er has not yet congratulated him in person. But when I saw him today, he showed his restrained power and extraordinary aura. It is really a great blessing for my Jiang family."
Jiang Yuan's words were extremely sincere. He didn't have the airs of a powerful person in the later stages of the Great Emperor. He was just a well-behaved and sensible junior.
Jiang Shouzhuo was at a loss by Jiang Yuan's sudden bow, and quickly reached out to help him up. The embarrassment on his old face became even more intense: "Ahem... Well, Yuan'er, get up, get up.
Your...your cultivation really scares the Third Uncle to death.
How can San Bo dare to boast of his power in front of you with his humble deeds..."
Jiang Yuan held Jiang Shouzhuo's hand instead, with a sincere look, "No matter how high Yuan'er's cultivation is or what realm he reaches, in this Jiang family, I will always be your nephew.
Seniority, inferiority, and blood ties, how can they be obliterated by mere cultivation? The third uncle has endured for many years for the sake of his family, but now he is convinced that this is your ability. Yuan'er is where he is today thanks to the protection of his family and elders. "
Jiang Yuan said these words resoundingly and from the bottom of his heart.
Although he, Jiang Yuan, behaves domineeringly and is ruthless to outsiders, he has absolute respect and protection for the Jiang family and the elders who have watched him grow up and even doted on him when he was a mortal.
He patted Jiang Yuan's shoulder heavily, and the trace of loss and embarrassment in his heart instantly disappeared, replaced by endless relief and pride.
Just saying this to you, if anyone dares to touch a hair on your face in the future, Uncle San will beat him to death even if it means risking his life! "
The atmosphere in the hall became harmonious again because of the warm interaction between the uncle and nephew.
"Okay, okay, you two should stop flattering each other."
The Fourth Ancestor laughed loudly, "Yuan'er, you showed off your tricks on purpose today and scared us old guys so much. It must not just be to show off, right? You also brought a girl here. Tell me, what happened?"
Jiang Yuan chuckled and pointed at the little Danxian standing next to him, who didn't even dare to breathe.
"It's nothing big. I just want to send an apprentice to Third Grandpa."
